sloka: नष्टज्वलनसम्पाता प्रशान्ताध्यायसत्कथा ।तिमिरेणाभिलिप्तेव तदा सा नगरी बभौ ॥२-४८-३४॥
transliteration: naṣṭajvalanasampātā praśāntādhyāyasatkathā ।timireṇābhilipteva tadā sā nagarī babhau ॥2-48-34॥

translations.english: With sacrificial fires extinguished and the reading of holy scriptures and sacred recitations stopped, Ayodhya looked as if besmeared with darkness.
